WAIVER OF TENTATIVE
AND PARCEL MAP

The attached application must be filled out completely to include the names, addresses and
signature(s) of the applicant(s). A Pre-Application Review is required with the application.
Along with the application and Pre-Application Review, PDF copy of a site plan, showing the proposed
transaction must be provided. The map must be drawn to scale and include the following information:
1. The boundary lines, dimensions and areas of the original parcel(s).
2. The proposed division lines, dimensions, and areas of each parcel to be created.
3. The identification of each parcel with a number or letter.
4. All existing buildings, structures, wells, septic systems, and other improvements and their distances
from proposed or existing property lines, or a note stating there are no improvements on the
property.
5. The location and width of any abutting public or private road right-of-way.
6. The location of proposed or existing private road easements with the connection to a public road.
7. North arrow and scale.
A copy of the recorded deed showing transfer of title, of the original parcel involved in the transaction,
to the applicant(s).
A Statement of Intended use is required for land subject to a Williamson Act Contract.
THE FILING FEE FOR THE TPMW APPLICATION IS $1,303.34 (plus $27.57 PER PARCEL), a
Health Department review fee of $305.00; and an Environmental Review fee of $291.51 along
with a completed & signed application is required.
Approval of the application will require the filing of a Waiver Certificate, prepared by a Licensed Land
Surveyor or a Registered Civil Engineer authorized to perform land surveying.
THE WAIVER CERTIFICATE FILING FEE IS $1,105.25 (plus $83.85 PER PARCEL).
THE FOLLOWING FEES MAY APPLY SHOULD THE TPMW REQUIRE AN INITIAL STUDY:
$1,364.12, plus $338.00 for Health Department Review. An Archaeological Review fee of $75.00 on a
separate check made out to CSU Bakersfield may also be required. If an Initial Study is required during
the mapping application process the $291.51 Environmental Review fee will be credited towards the
$1,364.12 Initial Study fee.
